221	def validate_intent_dict(
222	    intent: dict[str, Any],
223	    *,
224	    write_prefixes: list[str] | None = None,
225	    allow_gui: bool | None = None,
226	) -> None:
227	    """Validate an intent payload against CONTRACT.md §5.1 and §4.2."""
228	    required_keys = (
229	        "v",
230	        "event_id",
231	        "agent_id",
232	        "lane",
233	        "action_class",
234	        "kind",
235	        "based_on_frame",
236	        "view_epoch",
237	        "scene_epoch",
238	        "lease_epoch",
239	        "write_set",
240	        "target_region",
241	        "footprint",
242	        "expect",
243	        "script",
244	        "script_sha256",
245	        "keys",
246	        "max_acts",
247	        "created_ts_ms",
248	    )
249	    for key in required_keys:
250	        if key not in intent:
251	            raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"Missing required field: {key}")
252	
253	    if intent["v"] != CONTRACT_VERSION:
254	        raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"v must be {CONTRACT_VERSION}")
255	
256	    agent_id = intent["agent_id"]
257	    event_id = intent["event_id"]
258	    if not isinstance(agent_id, str) or not AGENT_ID_RE.match(agent_id):
259	        raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"Invalid agent_id: {agent_id!r}")
260	    if not isinstance(event_id, str) or not EVENT_ID_RE.match(event_id):
261	        raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"Invalid event_id: {event_id!r}")
262	
263	    for int_field in ("based_on_frame", "view_epoch", "scene_epoch", "lease_epoch", "created_ts_ms"):
264	        if not isinstance(intent[int_field], int) or isinstance(intent[int_field], bool):
265	            raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{int_field} must be int")
266	
267	    if not isinstance(intent["expect"], str) or not intent["expect"].strip():
268	        raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "expect must be a non-empty string")
269	
270	    lane = intent["lane"]
271	    if lane == "script":
272	        if intent["action_class"] != "state_job" or intent["kind"] != "job":
273	            raise IntentValidationError(
274	                "VALIDATION_ERROR", "script lane requires action_class='state_job', kind='job'"
275	            )
276	        write_set = intent["write_set"]
277	        if not isinstance(write_set, list) or not write_set or not all(
278	            isinstance(w, str) and w for w in write_set
279	        ):
280	            raise IntentValidationError(
281	                "CLAIM_REFUSED", "script lane requires a non-empty list[str] write_set"
282	            )
283	        prefixes = (
284	            write_prefixes
285	            if write_prefixes is not None
286	            else AGENT_SPECS.get(agent_id, {}).get("write_prefixes", [])
287	        )
288	        if not prefixes:
289	            raise IntentValidationError(
290	                "NO_LEASE", f"No write_prefixes configured for agent {agent_id}"
291	            )
292	        for entry in write_set:
293	            if not any(entry.startswith(p) for p in prefixes):
294	                raise IntentValidationError(
295	                    "CLAIM_REFUSED",
296	                    f"write_set entry {entry!r} violates prefixes {prefixes}",
297	                )
298	        script = intent["script"]
299	        if not isinstance(script, str) or not script.strip():
300	            raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "script must be non-empty str")
301	        expected_sha = hashlib.sha256(script.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
302	        if intent["script_sha256"] != expected_sha:
303	            raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "script_sha256 mismatch")
304	        if intent["keys"] is not None or intent["max_acts"] != 1:
305	            raise IntentValidationError(
306	                "VALIDATION_ERROR", "script lane requires keys=null and max_acts=1"
307	            )
308	    elif lane == "gui":
309	        gui_ok = (
310	            allow_gui
311	            if allow_gui is not None
312	            else bool(AGENT_SPECS.get(agent_id, {}).get("allow_gui", False))
313	        )
314	        if not gui_ok or agent_id != "camera-agent":
315	            raise IntentValidationError(
316	                "CLAIM_REFUSED",
317	                f"GUI lane is permitted only for camera-agent (got {agent_id!r})",
318	            )
319	        if intent["action_class"] != "view_change" or intent["kind"] != "key":
320	            raise IntentValidationError(
321	                "VALIDATION_ERROR", "gui key lane requires action_class='view_change', kind='key'"
322	            )
323	        footprint = intent["footprint"]
324	        if (
325	            not isinstance(footprint, list)
326	            or len(footprint) != 4
327	            or not all(isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool) for v in footprint)
328	            or footprint[2] <= 0
329	            or footprint[3] <= 0
330	        ):
331	            raise IntentValidationError(
332	                "FOOTPRINT_MISSING",
333	                "gui lane requires footprint=[x,y,w,h] with w>0, h>0",
334	            )
335	        keys = intent["keys"]
336	        if not isinstance(keys, list) or not (1 <= len(keys) <= 8):
337	            raise IntentValidationError(
338	                "CLAIM_REFUSED", "gui keys must contain between 1 and 8 keys"
339	            )
340	        bad_keys = [k for k in keys if k not in ALLOWED_GUI_KEYS]
341	        if bad_keys:
342	            raise IntentValidationError(
343	                "CLAIM_REFUSED",
344	                f"Disallowed GUI key(s): {bad_keys}; allowed: {list(ALLOWED_GUI_KEYS)}",
345	            )
346	        if intent["max_acts"] != len(keys):
347	            raise IntentValidationError(
348	                "VALIDATION_ERROR", "gui max_acts must equal len(keys)"
349	            )
350	        if intent["script"] is not None or intent["script_sha256"] is not None:
351	            raise IntentValidationError(
352	                "VALIDATION_ERROR", "gui lane requires script=null and script_sha256=null"
353	            )
354	    else:
355	        raise IntentValidationError("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"Unsupported lane: {lane!r}")
356

371	def _atomic_write_json_file(target_path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
372	    target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
373	    tmp_path = target_path.with_name(f".{target_path.name}.tmp.{os.getpid()}")
374	    serialized = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=False) + "\n"
375	    try:
376	        with tmp_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
377	            fh.write(serialized)
378	            fh.flush()
379	            os.fsync(fh.fileno())
380	        os.replace(tmp_path, target_path)
381	        _fsync_dir(target_path.parent)
382	    except Exception:
383	        if tmp_path.exists():
384	            tmp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
385	        raise
386	    return target_path

437	def load_enqueue_offset(
438	    *,
439	    event_id: str,
440	    intents_dir: Path | None = None,
441	    agent_id: str | None = None,
442	) -> int | None:
443	    """Load recorded events.jsonl byte offset for event_id if present."""
444	    root = Path(intents_dir) if intents_dir is not None else DEFAULT_INTENTS_DIR
445	    candidates: list[Path] = []
446	    if agent_id:
447	        candidates.append(offset_metadata_path(root, agent_id, event_id))
448	    else:
449	        bound = os.environ.get("SWARM_AGENT_ID")
450	        if bound:
451	            candidates.append(offset_metadata_path(root, bound, event_id))
452	        if root.is_dir():
453	            candidates.extend(sorted(root.glob(f"*/.offsets/{event_id}.json")))
454	
455	    best_offset: int | None = None
456	    best_ts = -1
457	    seen: set[Path] = set()
458	    for cand in candidates:
459	        if cand in seen or not cand.is_file():
460	            continue
461	        seen.add(cand)
462	        try:
463	            data = json.loads(cand.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
464	        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
465	            continue
466	        if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("offset_bytes"), int):
467	            ts_ms = int(data.get("created_ts_ms", 0))
468	            if best_offset is None or ts_ms >= best_ts:
469	                best_ts = ts_ms
470	                best_offset = max(0, int(data["offset_bytes"]))
471	    return best_offset

615	    *,
616	    event_id: str,
617	    events_log: Path,
618	    timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S,
619	    poll_interval_s: float = 0.2,
620	    from_offset: int | None = None,
621	    intents_dir: Path | None = None,
622	    agent_id: str | None = None,
623	) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
624	    """Tail events_log from >= offset_bytes until a terminal close receipt for event_id."""
625	    if from_offset is not None:
626	        start_offset = max(0, int(from_offset))
627	    else:
628	        loaded_offset = load_enqueue_offset(
629	            event_id=event_id,
630	            intents_dir=intents_dir,
631	            agent_id=agent_id,
632	        )
633	        start_offset = loaded_offset if loaded_offset is not None else 0
634	
635	    deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, timeout_s)
636	    offset = start_offset
637	    partial = ""
638	
639	    while True:
640	        if events_log.is_file():
641	            file_size = events_log.stat().st_size
642	            if file_size > offset:
643	                with events_log.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
644	                    fh.seek(offset)
645	                    chunk = fh.read()
646	                    offset = fh.tell()
647	                if chunk:
648	                    data = partial + chunk
649	                    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
650	                    partial = ""
651	                    if lines and not lines[-1].endswith("\n"):
652	                        partial = lines.pop()
653	                    for line in lines:
654	                        stripped = line.strip()
655	                        if not stripped:
656	                            continue
657	                        try:
658	                            rec = json.loads(stripped)
659	                        except json.JSONDecodeError:
660	                            continue
661	                        if (
662	                            isinstance(rec, dict)
663	                            and rec.get("rec") == "close"
664	                            and rec.get("event_id") == event_id
665	                        ):
666	                            verdict = str(rec.get("verdict", ""))
667	                            if verdict in VERDICT_SUCCESS:
668	                                return 0, rec
669	                            if verdict in VERDICT_NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE:
670	                                return 2, rec
671	                            if verdict in VERDICT_RETRYABLE_STALE:
672	                                drops = int(rec.get("drops", 0))
673	                                if drops >= STALE_MAX_DROPS:
674	                                    return 3, rec
675	                                continue
676	                            if verdict in VERDICT_QUEUE_REFUSAL:
677	                                return 4, rec
678	                            return 1, rec
679	        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
680	            raise WaitTimeoutError(
681	                f"Timed out after {timeout_s}s waiting for close receipt of {event_id!r}"
682	            )
683	        time.sleep(poll_interval_s)

116	def read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid: int) -> int | None:
117	    """Read field 22 (starttime in clock ticks) from /proc/<pid>/stat."""
118	    stat_path = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat")
119	    if not stat_path.is_file():
120	        return None
121	    try:
122	        raw = stat_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
123	    except OSError:
124	        return None
125	    parts = raw.rsplit(")", 1)
126	    if len(parts) != 2:
127	        return None
128	    after = parts[1].split()
129	    if len(after) <= 19:
130	        return None
131	    try:
132	        return int(after[19])
133	    except ValueError:
134	        return None

137	def _is_pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
138	    try:
139	        os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
140	    except ChildProcessError:
141	        pass
142	    try:
143	        os.kill(pid, 0)
144	    except ProcessLookupError:
145	        return False
146	    except PermissionError:
147	        return True
148	    stat_path = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat")
149	    if stat_path.is_file():
150	        try:
151	            parts = stat_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").rsplit(")", 1)
152	            if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].lstrip().startswith("Z"):
153	                return False
154	        except OSError:
155	            pass
156	    return True

175	def kill_recorded_pids(proof_dir: Path, run_tag: str | None = None, grace_s: float = 2.0) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
176	    """Terminate only processes whose PID and /proc/<pid>/stat starttime_ticks match .proc.json."""
177	    if not proof_dir.is_dir():
178	        return []
179	    proc_pattern = f"run_{run_tag}_*.proc.json" if run_tag else "run_*.proc.json"
180	    pid_pattern = f"run_{run_tag}_*.pid" if run_tag else "run_*.pid"
181	
182	    by_prefix: dict[str, dict[str, Path | None]] = {}
183	    for pf in sorted(proof_dir.glob(proc_pattern)):
184	        stem = pf.name[: -len(".proc.json")]
185	        by_prefix.setdefault(stem, {"proc_file": None, "pid_file": None})["proc_file"] = pf
186	    for pf in sorted(proof_dir.glob(pid_pattern)):
187	        stem = pf.stem
188	        by_prefix.setdefault(stem, {"proc_file": None, "pid_file": None})["pid_file"] = pf
189	
190	    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
191	    targets: list[tuple[Path | None, Path | None, int, int, str]] = []
192	
193	    for stem in sorted(by_prefix):
194	        proc_file = by_prefix[stem]["proc_file"]
195	        pid_file = by_prefix[stem]["pid_file"]
196	        if proc_file is None or not proc_file.is_file():
197	            outcomes.append(
198	                {
199	                    "pid_file": str(pid_file) if pid_file else None,
200	                    "status": "skipped_missing_proc_metadata",
201	                }
202	            )
203	            continue
204	        try:
205	            meta = json.loads(proc_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
206	        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
207	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "status": "invalid_proc_metadata"})
208	            continue
209	
210	        pid = meta.get("pid")
211	        expected_ticks = meta.get("starttime_ticks")
212	        unit_name = str(meta.get("unit") or "")
213	        if (
214	            not isinstance(pid, int)
215	            or isinstance(pid, bool)
216	            or not isinstance(expected_ticks, int)
217	            or isinstance(expected_ticks, bool)
218	        ):
219	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "status": "invalid_proc_metadata"})
220	            continue
221	
222	        if pid <= 1 or pid == os.getpid():
223	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "skipped_unsafe_pid"})
224	            continue
225	
226	        actual_ticks = read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid)
227	        if actual_ticks is None:
228	            _stop_scope_unit(unit_name)
229	            if pid_file is not None:
230	                pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
231	            proc_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
232	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "already_exited"})
233	            continue
234	
235	        if actual_ticks != expected_ticks:
236	            outcomes.append(
237	                {
238	                    "proc_file": str(proc_file),
239	                    "pid": pid,
240	                    "expected_starttime_ticks": expected_ticks,
241	                    "actual_starttime_ticks": actual_ticks,
242	                    "status": "skipped_starttime_mismatch",
243	                }
244	            )
245	            continue
246	
247	        targets.append((proc_file, pid_file, pid, expected_ticks, unit_name))
248	
249	    for proc_file, pid_file, pid, expected_ticks, unit_name in targets:
250	        if unit_name:
251	            _stop_scope_unit(unit_name)
252	        if read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid) != expected_ticks or not _is_pid_alive(pid):
253	            if pid_file is not None:
254	                pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
255	            proc_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
256	            outcomes.append(
257	                {"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "unit": unit_name, "status": "stopped_unit"}
258	            )
259	            continue
260	        try:
261	            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
262	            outcomes.append(
263	                {"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "unit": unit_name, "signal": "SIGTERM", "status": "signaled"}
264	            )
265	        except ProcessLookupError:
266	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "already_exited"})
267	        except PermissionError as exc:
268	            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": f"permission_error: {exc}"})
269

"""Parallel headless agy agent launcher and PID lifecycle manager (H2)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from swarm.agents import (
    CANONICAL_ROLES,
    DEFAULT_BRIEFS_DIR,
    DEFAULT_PROOF_DIR,
    REPO_ROOT,
)
from swarm.agents.prompts import build_brief

AGY_BIN = "~/.local/bin/agy"
DEFAULT_GOMEMLIMIT = "6GiB"
DEFAULT_MODEL = "gemini-4-hydrogen-high"
DEFAULT_PRINT_TIMEOUT = "1800s"


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def scope_unit_name(run_tag: str, role: str) -> str:
    return f"vpswarm-agent-{run_tag}-{role}"


def build_scope_prefix(unit_name: str) -> list[str]:
    """Build deterministic 6G/8G systemd-run user scope command prefix."""
    return [
        "systemd-run",
        "--user",
        "--scope",
        f"--unit={unit_name}",
        "-q",
        "-p",
        "MemoryHigh=6G",
        "-p",
        "MemoryMax=8G",
        "-p",
        "MemorySwapMax=0",
    ]


def build_agent_env(
    role: str,
    base_env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Preserve shim GOMEMLIMIT and bind SWARM_AGENT_ID without invoking the 12G/16G shim."""
    env = dict(os.environ if base_env is None else base_env)
    env.setdefault("GOMEMLIMIT", DEFAULT_GOMEMLIMIT)
    env["SWARM_AGENT_ID"] = role
    return env


def build_agent_argv(
    *,
    role: str,
    model: str,
    cli_log_path: Path,
    print_timeout: str,
    brief: str,
    run_tag: str = "manual",
) -> list[str]:
    """Build exact systemd-run + real agy binary argv with -p as the very last flag."""
    unit_name = scope_unit_name(run_tag, role)
    return [
        *build_scope_prefix(unit_name),
        AGY_BIN,
        "--model",
        model,
        "--dangerously-skip-permissions",
        "--output-format",
        "stream-json",
        "--log-file",
        str(cli_log_path),
        "--print-timeout",
        print_timeout,
        "-p",
        brief,
    ]


def parse_roles(raw_roles: str) -> list[str]:
    roles = [r.strip() for r in raw_roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
    if not roles:
        raise ValueError("At least one role must be specified")
    unknown = [r for r in roles if r not in CANONICAL_ROLES]
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown role(s): {unknown}; expected subset of {list(CANONICAL_ROLES)}")
    return roles


def read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid: int) -> int | None:
    """Read field 22 (starttime in clock ticks) from /proc/<pid>/stat."""
    stat_path = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat")
    if not stat_path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        raw = stat_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    except OSError:
        return None
    parts = raw.rsplit(")", 1)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return None
    after = parts[1].split()
    if len(after) <= 19:
        return None
    try:
        return int(after[19])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _is_pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
    try:
        os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
    except ChildProcessError:
        pass
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return False
    except PermissionError:
        return True
    stat_path = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat")
    if stat_path.is_file():
        try:
            parts = stat_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").rsplit(")", 1)
            if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].lstrip().startswith("Z"):
                return False
        except OSError:
            pass
    return True


def _stop_scope_unit(unit_name: str) -> None:
    if not unit_name.startswith("vpswarm-agent-"):
        return
    scope = unit_name if unit_name.endswith(".scope") else f"{unit_name}.scope"
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            ["systemctl", "--user", "stop", scope],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=5.0,
            check=False,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        pass


def kill_recorded_pids(proof_dir: Path, run_tag: str | None = None, grace_s: float = 2.0) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Terminate only processes whose PID and /proc/<pid>/stat starttime_ticks match .proc.json."""
    if not proof_dir.is_dir():
        return []
    proc_pattern = f"run_{run_tag}_*.proc.json" if run_tag else "run_*.proc.json"
    pid_pattern = f"run_{run_tag}_*.pid" if run_tag else "run_*.pid"

    by_prefix: dict[str, dict[str, Path | None]] = {}
    for pf in sorted(proof_dir.glob(proc_pattern)):
        stem = pf.name[: -len(".proc.json")]
        by_prefix.setdefault(stem, {"proc_file": None, "pid_file": None})["proc_file"] = pf
    for pf in sorted(proof_dir.glob(pid_pattern)):
        stem = pf.stem
        by_prefix.setdefault(stem, {"proc_file": None, "pid_file": None})["pid_file"] = pf

    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    targets: list[tuple[Path | None, Path | None, int, int, str]] = []

    for stem in sorted(by_prefix):
        proc_file = by_prefix[stem]["proc_file"]
        pid_file = by_prefix[stem]["pid_file"]
        if proc_file is None or not proc_file.is_file():
            outcomes.append(
                {
                    "pid_file": str(pid_file) if pid_file else None,
                    "status": "skipped_missing_proc_metadata",
                }
            )
            continue
        try:
            meta = json.loads(proc_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "status": "invalid_proc_metadata"})
            continue

        pid = meta.get("pid")
        expected_ticks = meta.get("starttime_ticks")
        unit_name = str(meta.get("unit") or "")
        if (
            not isinstance(pid, int)
            or isinstance(pid, bool)
            or not isinstance(expected_ticks, int)
            or isinstance(expected_ticks, bool)
        ):
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "status": "invalid_proc_metadata"})
            continue

        if pid <= 1 or pid == os.getpid():
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "skipped_unsafe_pid"})
            continue

        actual_ticks = read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid)
        if actual_ticks is None:
            _stop_scope_unit(unit_name)
            if pid_file is not None:
                pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            proc_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "already_exited"})
            continue

        if actual_ticks != expected_ticks:
            outcomes.append(
                {
                    "proc_file": str(proc_file),
                    "pid": pid,
                    "expected_starttime_ticks": expected_ticks,
                    "actual_starttime_ticks": actual_ticks,
                    "status": "skipped_starttime_mismatch",
                }
            )
            continue

        targets.append((proc_file, pid_file, pid, expected_ticks, unit_name))

    for proc_file, pid_file, pid, expected_ticks, unit_name in targets:
        if unit_name:
            _stop_scope_unit(unit_name)
        if read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid) != expected_ticks or not _is_pid_alive(pid):
            if pid_file is not None:
                pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            proc_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            outcomes.append(
                {"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "unit": unit_name, "status": "stopped_unit"}
            )
            continue
        try:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            outcomes.append(
                {"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "unit": unit_name, "signal": "SIGTERM", "status": "signaled"}
            )
        except ProcessLookupError:
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": "already_exited"})
        except PermissionError as exc:
            outcomes.append({"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "status": f"permission_error: {exc}"})

    if targets:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + grace_s
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if not any(
                _is_pid_alive(pid) and read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid) == expected_ticks
                for _, _, pid, expected_ticks, _ in targets
            ):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)

        for proc_file, pid_file, pid, expected_ticks, _ in targets:
            if _is_pid_alive(pid) and read_proc_starttime_ticks(pid) == expected_ticks:
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    outcomes.append(
                        {"proc_file": str(proc_file), "pid": pid, "signal": "SIGKILL", "status": "force_killed"}
                    )
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
            if not _is_pid_alive(pid):
                if pid_file is not None:
                    pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                if proc_file is not None:
                    proc_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    return outcomes


def run_agents(
    *,
    roles: list[str],
    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
    print_timeout: str = DEFAULT_PRINT_TIMEOUT,
    run_tag: str | None = None,
    proof_dir: Path = DEFAULT_PROOF_DIR,
    briefs_dir: Path = DEFAULT_BRIEFS_DIR,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tag = run_tag or datetime.now().strftime("%H%M%S")
    briefs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    proof_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    planned: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for role in roles:
        brief = build_brief(role, run_id=f"run_{tag}")
        brief_path = briefs_dir / f"{role}.md"
        brief_path.write_text(brief, encoding="utf-8")

        prefix = f"run_{tag}_{role}"
        unit_name = scope_unit_name(tag, role)
        cli_log = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.cli.log"
        jsonl_log = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.jsonl"
        stderr_log = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.stderr.log"
        pid_file = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.pid"
        proc_file = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.proc.json"
        started_file = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.started_at.txt"
        finished_file = proof_dir / f"{prefix}.finished_at.txt"

        argv = build_agent_argv(
            role=role,
            model=model,
            cli_log_path=cli_log,
            print_timeout=print_timeout,
            brief=brief,
            run_tag=tag,
        )
        planned.append(
            {
                "role": role,
                "unit_name": unit_name,
                "brief_path": str(brief_path),
                "brief_sha256": hashlib.sha256(brief.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                "cli_log": cli_log,
                "jsonl_log": jsonl_log,
                "stderr_log": stderr_log,
                "pid_file": pid_file,
                "proc_file": proc_file,
                "started_file": started_file,
                "finished_file": finished_file,
                "argv": argv,
                "env": build_agent_env(role),
            }
        )

    if dry_run:
        return {
            "mode": "dry_run",
            "run_tag": tag,
            "model": model,
            "agents": [
                {
                    "role": item["role"],
                    "unit": item["unit_name"],
                    "brief_path": item["brief_path"],
                    "brief_sha256": item["brief_sha256"],
                    "argv_display": item["argv"][:-1] + [f"<brief:{len(item['argv'][-1])}chars>"],
                    "argv": item["argv"],
                }
                for item in planned
            ],
        }

    procs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], subprocess.Popen[bytes], Any, Any]] = []
    for item in planned:
        started_ts = utc_now_iso()
        item["started_file"].write_text(started_ts + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        item["started_at"] = started_ts

        out_fh = item["jsonl_log"].open("wb")
        err_fh = item["stderr_log"].open("wb")
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            item["argv"],
            cwd=str(REPO_ROOT),
            env=item["env"],
            stdout=out_fh,
            stderr=err_fh,
        )
        starttime_ticks = read_proc_starttime_ticks(proc.pid)
        item["pid_file"].write_text(f"{proc.pid}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        item["proc_file"].write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "pid": proc.pid,
                    "starttime_ticks": starttime_ticks,
                    "unit": item["unit_name"],
                    "role": item["role"],
                    "run_tag": tag,
                },
                indent=2,
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        item["pid"] = proc.pid
        procs.append((item, proc, out_fh, err_fh))

    summary_agents: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    overall_rc = 0
    for item, proc, out_fh, err_fh in procs:
        rc = proc.wait()
        out_fh.close()
        err_fh.close()
        item["pid_file"].unlink(missing_ok=True)
        item["proc_file"].unlink(missing_ok=True)
        finished_ts = utc_now_iso()
        item["finished_file"].write_text(finished_ts + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if rc != 0 and overall_rc == 0:
            overall_rc = rc

        summary_agents.append(
            {
                "role": item["role"],
                "unit": item["unit_name"],
                "pid": item["pid"],
                "returncode": rc,
                "started_at": item["started_at"],
                "finished_at": finished_ts,
                "brief_path": item["brief_path"],
                "brief_sha256": item["brief_sha256"],
                "jsonl_log": str(item["jsonl_log"]),
                "jsonl_sha256": sha256_file(item["jsonl_log"]),
                "cli_log": str(item["cli_log"]),
                "cli_log_sha256": sha256_file(item["cli_log"]),
                "stderr_log": str(item["stderr_log"]),
                "stderr_sha256": sha256_file(item["stderr_log"]),
            }
        )

    summary = {
        "mode": "live",
        "run_tag": tag,
        "model": model,
        "overall_returncode": overall_rc,
        "agents": summary_agents,
    }
    summary_path = proof_dir / f"run_{tag}_summary.json"
    summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    summary["summary_path"] = str(summary_path)
    return summary


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python3 -m swarm.agents.runner",
        description="Parallel headless agy agent runner inside systemd-run memory scopes.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--roles",
        default=",".join(CANONICAL_ROLES),
        help="Comma-separated roles to launch",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL)
    parser.add_argument("--print-timeout", default=DEFAULT_PRINT_TIMEOUT)
    parser.add_argument("--run-tag", default=None, help="Optional <HHMMSS> tag override")
    parser.add_argument("--proof-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_PROOF_DIR))
    parser.add_argument("--briefs-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_BRIEFS_DIR))
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--kill-all", action="store_true")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    proof_dir = Path(args.proof_dir)
    briefs_dir = Path(args.briefs_dir)

    if args.kill_all:
        outcomes = kill_recorded_pids(proof_dir, run_tag=args.run_tag)
        print(json.dumps({"action": "kill_all", "outcomes": outcomes}, indent=2))
        return 0

    roles = parse_roles(args.roles)
    summary = run_agents(
        roles=roles,
        model=args.model,
        print_timeout=args.print_timeout,
        run_tag=args.run_tag,
        proof_dir=proof_dir,
        briefs_dir=briefs_dir,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )
    if args.dry_run:
        for item in summary["agents"]:
            print(f"[{item['role']}] brief={item['brief_path']} sha256={item['brief_sha256']}")
            print("  " + " ".join(item["argv_display"]))
        return 0

    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    return 0 if summary["overall_returncode"] == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

144	def build_brief(role: str, run_id: str | None = None) -> str:
145	    """Assemble a role brief guaranteed to begin byte-for-byte with SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX."""
146	    if role not in ROLE_SUFFIXES:
147	        raise KeyError(
148	            f"Unknown role {role!r}; expected one of {list(CANONICAL_ROLES)}"
149	        )
150	    spec = AGENT_SPECS[role]
151	    effective_run_id = run_id or "run-local"
152	    suffix = ROLE_SUFFIXES[role].replace("{run_id}", effective_run_id)
153	    prefix_check = (
154	        f"\n- **Configured Write Prefixes**: `{spec['write_prefixes']}`"
155	        f"\n- **Configured Allow GUI**: `{spec['allow_gui']}`"
156	        f"\n- **Run ID**: `{effective_run_id}`\n"
157	    )
158	    return SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX + suffix + prefix_check
159	
160	
161	def validate_shared_prefix(min_bytes: int = 1200) -> dict[str, int]:
162	    """Verify SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX >= min_bytes and identical at byte 0 for all 4 roles."""
163	    prefix_bytes = SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX.encode("utf-8")
164	    if len(prefix_bytes) < min_bytes:
165	        raise AssertionError(
166	            f"SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX must be >= {min_bytes} bytes, got {len(prefix_bytes)}"
167	        )
168	    sizes: dict[str, int] = {}
169	    for role in CANONICAL_ROLES:
170	        brief_bytes = build_brief(role).encode("utf-8")
171	        if brief_bytes[: len(prefix_bytes)] != prefix_bytes:
172	            raise AssertionError(f"Role {role!r} brief does not match SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX at offset 0")
173	        sizes[role] = len(brief_bytes)
174	    return sizes

   - GUI turns (`camera-agent` ONLY): `python3 -m swarm.agents.intent_cli enqueue-gui --agent camera-agent --event-id <run_id>-camera-agent-<step> --keys <keys> --footprint 0,80,1580,900 --expect "<post_condition>"`
   - Await close receipt: `python3 -m swarm.agents.intent_cli wait-event --event-id <run_id>-<YOUR_AGENT_ID>-<step> --events-log swarm/run/events.jsonl --timeout-s 540`
   - Write your temporary `.py` scripts under `/tmp/swarm_scripts/<YOUR_AGENT_ID>/` (never modify files owned by other units).
6. **Strict Claim Ownership (`write_prefixes`) — Zero Cross-Claim Writes**:
   - Every entry in `--write-set` MUST start with one of your assigned `write_prefixes` and list EVERY resource mutated by your script (e.g. `camera-agent` MUST declare `render:engine` alongside `cam:MainCam` when setting `scene.render.engine`).
   - NEVER delete, rename, hide, or mutate Blender objects, collections, materials, lights, cameras, or `scene.render`/`scene.eevee` settings outside your prefix (NEVER touch factory `Cube` or another agent's meshes).
   - Pure-datablock material binding: `modeler-agent` and `props-agent` assign named `bpy.data.materials` datablocks (`bpy.data.materials.get(n) or bpy.data.materials.new(n)`) ONLY on their OWN `CHAR_*` / `PROP_*` meshes; `look-agent` updates `mat.use_nodes` and Principled BSDF shader nodes in-place ONLY on `bpy.data.materials[n]` without touching `CHAR_*`, `PROP_*`, `scene.render.*`, or `scene.eevee.*`.
   - Write idempotent `bmesh` + `bpy.data` scripts (avoid fragile `bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_*_add` viewport polls inside `bpy.app.timers`); delete/recreate ONLY your own named objects/materials if re-running.
7. **Verdict & Exit-Code Rules (All §6 Codes)**:
   - `rc == 0` (`STATE_VERIFIED`, `VERIFIED`, `VERIFIED_WITH_SPILL`): completed! Proceed to the next step.
   - `rc == 2` (`NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`): executed GUI act (`tick + 1`, zero pixel diff). **NEVER repeat or re-enqueue blindly!** Treat as a completed observation step, inspect `frame_<N>.png`, and adjust or proceed.
   - `rc == 3` (`STALE_FRAME` parked at `drops == 3`; note `wait-event` automatically waits through broker tail-requeues `drops < 3`): re-run `observe` to read fresh `latest.json`, then enqueue ONE fresh `<run_id>-` `event_id` with current `based_on_frame`.
   - `rc == 4` (`DUPLICATE_EVENT`, `QUEUE_FULL`): on `DUPLICATE_EVENT`, check `observe` and mint a unique `<run_id>-` ID only if the step did not run; on `QUEUE_FULL` (8 pending intents max), wait for pending events before enqueueing more.
   - `rc == 124` (`TIMEOUT` CLI wait timeout): the event may still be in queue or executing — **re-run `wait-event` on the SAME `event_id`**, NEVER re-enqueue!
   - `rc == 1` (hard refusal/error/uncertain):
     - `CLAIM_REFUSED` / `FOOTPRINT_MISSING`: fix `write_set` / `keys` / `footprint` within your claim before minting a fresh `<run_id>-` ID.
     - `JOB_ERROR`: inspect error / `frame_<N>.png`, fix script, mint fresh `<run_id>-` ID.
     - `FRAME_EVICTED`: run full `observe` to read current `latest.json` before enqueueing a fresh `<run_id>-` ID.
     - `NO_LEASE` / `LEASE_EXPIRED`: run `observe` to refresh `lease_epoch`; if unleased or parked, stop.
     - `TURN_TIMEOUT` / `ACTUATOR_BUSY`: do not flood queue; run `observe` (2 consecutive `TURN_TIMEOUT`s park your agent).
     - `INPUT_UNCERTAIN` / `OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN`: **NEVER auto-repeat!** Stop and report uncertainty.
8. **Single TaskLight (`context-wall`) Owner**:
   - **H4 (`swarm/projection/projector.py`) is the sole owner of TaskLight `context-wall` calls**; agents MUST NOT call `post_plan`, `post_step`, `post_status`, or `close_task` directly.
"""

def build_brief(role: str, run_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Assemble a role brief guaranteed to begin byte-for-byte with SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX."""
    if role not in ROLE_SUFFIXES:
        raise KeyError(
            f"Unknown role {role!r}; expected one of {list(CANONICAL_ROLES)}"
        )
    spec = AGENT_SPECS[role]
    effective_run_id = run_id or "run-local"
    suffix = ROLE_SUFFIXES[role].replace("{run_id}", effective_run_id)
    prefix_check = (
        f"\n- **Configured Write Prefixes**: `{spec['write_prefixes']}`"
        f"\n- **Configured Allow GUI**: `{spec['allow_gui']}`"
        f"\n- **Run ID**: `{effective_run_id}`\n"
    )
    return SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX + suffix + prefix_check


def validate_shared_prefix(min_bytes: int = 1200) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Verify SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX >= min_bytes and identical at byte 0 for all 4 roles."""
    prefix_bytes = SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX.encode("utf-8")
    if len(prefix_bytes) < min_bytes:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX must be >= {min_bytes} bytes, got {len(prefix_bytes)}"
        )
    sizes: dict[str, int] = {}
    for role in CANONICAL_ROLES:
        brief_bytes = build_brief(role).encode("utf-8")
        if brief_bytes[: len(prefix_bytes)] != prefix_bytes:
            raise AssertionError(f"Role {role!r} brief does not match SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX at offset 0")
        sizes[role] = len(brief_bytes)
    return sizes

# ViewPoint Swarm Agents SDK & Runner (`swarm/agents/`)

Implements the **H2** multi-agent layer strictly adhering to `swarm/CONTRACT.md`:
- Read-only inspection of `/dev/shm/vqa-cu/swarm/frames/` (`latest.json` + `frame_<N>.png`)
- Atomic intent enqueueing (`.tmp` + `os.replace()`) strictly to `/dev/shm/vqa-cu/swarm/intents/<agent_id>/<event_id>.json`
- Never calls `vision`; never writes to `SWARM_INBOX` (`/dev/shm/vqa-cu/swarm/inbox`)

## Modules

- `swarm/agents/__init__.py`: Canonical role definitions, write prefixes, allowed GUI keys (`KP_1`, `KP_3`, `KP_7`, `KP_4`, `KP_Add`, `Home`), and default paths.
- `swarm/agents/intent_cli.py`: Deterministic CLI (`observe`, `enqueue-script`, `enqueue-gui`, `wait-event`) enforcing `CONTRACT.md` §5.1 schemas, claim prefixes, GUI key/agent constraints, inbox write refusal, run-scoped `.offsets/<event_id>.json` log offsets, `--timeout-s 540`, and `wait-event` exit codes (`0` verified, `2` `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`, `3` `STALE_FRAME` parked at `drops == 3`, `4` `DUPLICATE_EVENT`/`QUEUE_FULL`, `124` CLI timeout, `1` hard error without auto-repeating `INPUT_UNCERTAIN`/`OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN`).
- `swarm/agents/prompts.py`: Byte-identical `SHARED_BRIEF_PREFIX` (`>= 1200` bytes at offset `0`) + run-scoped `ROLE_SUFFIXES` for `modeler-agent`, `props-agent`, `look-agent`, and `camera-agent` collaborating on **StarForge Sentinel**, with H4 (`swarm/projection/projector.py`) as the sole TaskLight (`context-wall`) owner.
- `swarm/agents/scripted_smoke.py`: Non-LLM deterministic scripted producer (`--agents 2|4`, `--demo-stale-rebase`, `--dry-run`) using Blender 4.0.2 `bmesh` + `bpy.data` pure-datablock scripts and `intent_cli.py`.
- `swarm/agents/runner.py`: Parallel headless `~/.local/bin/agy` launcher inside deterministic `systemd-run --user --scope --unit=vpswarm-agent-<run_tag>-<role> -q -p MemoryHigh=6G -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0` (with `GOMEMLIMIT` and `SWARM_AGENT_ID`), `--dry-run`, `--kill-all` (verifying `/proc/<pid>/stat` `starttime_ticks` from `.proc.json`), proof logs, and SHA-256 summary JSON.
- `swarm/agents/test_agents.py`: Unit tests and negative controls.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Run unit tests inside systemd-run memory scope
systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryHigh=6G -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 \
  python3 -m unittest discover -s swarm/agents -p 'test_*.py' -v

# Dry-run 4-agent briefs and exact agy command lines
python3 -m swarm.agents.runner --dry-run

# Dry-run 4-agent scripted smoke
python3 -m swarm.agents.scripted_smoke --agents 4 --dry-run

# Live 4-agent scripted smoke with STALE_FRAME rebase demo (requires running H1 broker)
python3 -m swarm.agents.scripted_smoke --agents 4 --demo-stale-rebase --output-dir swarm/run/output
```

def _enqueue_and_wait_gui_with_rebase(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    base_event_id: str,
    keys: list[str],
    footprint: list[int],
    expect: str,
    frames_dir: Path,
    intents_dir: Path,
    events_log: Path,
    timeout_s: float,
    force_initial_stale: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Enqueue GUI intent, handling STALE_FRAME (rc=3 at drops>=3) by re-observing latest.json."""
    stale_observed: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    max_attempts = 4

    for attempt in range(max_attempts):
        event_id = base_event_id if attempt == 0 else f"{base_event_id}-r{attempt}"
        obs = observe_state(frames_dir=frames_dir, events_log=events_log, agent_id=agent_id)
        frame_override = None
        if force_initial_stale and attempt == 0:
            cur_frame = int(obs["frame"])
            if cur_frame < 1:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"--demo-stale-rebase requires head_frame >= 1 before GUI step, got {cur_frame}"
                )
            frame_override = cur_frame - 1

        intent, _ = build_gui_intent(
            agent_id=agent_id,
            event_id=event_id,
            keys=keys,
            footprint=footprint,
            expect=expect,
            frames_dir=frames_dir,
            events_log=events_log,
            based_on_frame_override=frame_override,
        )
        offset_bytes = record_enqueue_offset(
            intents_dir=intents_dir,
            agent_id=agent_id,
            event_id=event_id,
            events_log=events_log,
            created_ts_ms=intent["created_ts_ms"],
            script_sha256=intent["script_sha256"],
        )
        target_path = intents_dir / agent_id / f"{event_id}.json"
        atomic_write_json(target_path, intent, intents_dir)
        rc, receipt = wait_for_close_event(
            event_id=event_id,
            events_log=events_log,
            timeout_s=timeout_s,
            from_offset=offset_bytes,
            intents_dir=intents_dir,
            agent_id=agent_id,
        )
        if rc in (0, 2):
            if force_initial_stale and not stale_observed:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"--demo-stale-rebase expected at least one STALE_FRAME receipt for {base_event_id}"
                )
            return {
                "event_id": event_id,
                "rc": rc,
                "receipt": receipt,
                "stale_retries": stale_observed,
            }
        if rc == 3 and receipt.get("verdict") == "STALE_FRAME":
            stale_observed.append(receipt)
            continue
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"GUI event {event_id} failed (rc={rc}, verdict={receipt.get('verdict')}): {receipt}"
        )

    raise RuntimeError(f"GUI event {base_event_id} exhausted STALE_FRAME retries: {stale_observed}")


def run_smoke(
    *,
    num_agents: int,
    output_dir: Path,
    frames_dir: Path,
    intents_dir: Path,
    events_log: Path,
    run_id: str,
    timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S,
    demo_stale_rebase: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    res_x: int = 1280,
    res_y: int = 720,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    plan = build_smoke_plan(
        num_agents=num_agents,
        output_dir=output_dir,
        res_x=res_x,
        res_y=res_y,
    )

    if dry_run:
        validated: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for agent_id, steps in plan.items():
            for step in steps:
                event_id = f"{run_id}-{agent_id}-{step['suffix']}"
                if step["lane"] == "script":
                    script = step["script"]
                    compile(script, f"{event_id}.py", "exec")
                    intent = {
                        "v": 1,
                        "event_id": event_id,
                        "agent_id": agent_id,
                        "lane": "script",
                        "action_class": "state_job",
                        "kind": "job",
                        "based_on_frame": 0,
                        "view_epoch": 0,
                        "scene_epoch": 0,
                        "lease_epoch": 1,
                        "write_set": step["write_set"],
                        "target_region": None,
                        "footprint": None,
                        "expect": step["expect"],
                        "script": script,
                        "script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(script.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                        "keys": None,
                        "max_acts": 1,
                        "cursor_xy": None,
                        "created_ts_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
                    }
                else:
                    intent = {
                        "v": 1,
                        "event_id": event_id,
                        "agent_id": agent_id,
                        "lane": "gui",
                        "action_class": "view_change",
                        "kind": "key",
                        "based_on_frame": 0,
                        "view_epoch": 0,
                        "scene_epoch": 0,
                        "lease_epoch": 1,
                        "write_set": [],
                        "target_region": None,
                        "footprint": step["footprint"],
                        "expect": step["expect"],
                        "script": None,
                        "script_sha256": None,
                        "keys": step["keys"],
                        "max_acts": len(step["keys"]),
                        "cursor_xy": [800, 500],
                        "created_ts_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
                    }
                validate_intent_dict(intent)
                validated.append(
                    {
                        "event_id": event_id,
                        "agent_id": agent_id,
                        "lane": step["lane"],
                        "write_set": intent["write_set"],
                        "keys": intent["keys"],
                    }
                )
        return {
            "mode": "dry_run",
            "agents": num_agents,
            "run_id": run_id,
            "intents_validated": len(validated),
            "steps": validated,
        }

    builders_done = threading.Event()
    builder_roles = [r for r in plan if r != "camera-agent"]
    builder_remaining = len(builder_roles)
    lock = threading.Lock()
    results: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {r: [] for r in plan}
    errors: list[str] = []

    def worker(agent_id: str, steps: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        nonlocal builder_remaining
        try:
            for step_idx, step in enumerate(steps):
                if step.get("after_builders") and not builders_done.wait(timeout=timeout_s):
                    raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for builder agents to finish")

                base_event_id = f"{run_id}-{agent_id}-{step['suffix']}"
                if step["lane"] == "script":
                    intent, _ = build_script_intent(
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        event_id=base_event_id,
                        write_set=step["write_set"],
                        expect=step["expect"],
                        script_source=step["script"],
                        frames_dir=frames_dir,
                        events_log=events_log,
                    )
                    offset_bytes = record_enqueue_offset(
                        intents_dir=intents_dir,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        event_id=base_event_id,
                        events_log=events_log,
                        created_ts_ms=intent["created_ts_ms"],
                        script_sha256=intent["script_sha256"],
                    )
                    target_path = intents_dir / agent_id / f"{base_event_id}.json"
                    atomic_write_json(target_path, intent, intents_dir)
                    rc, receipt = wait_for_close_event(
                        event_id=base_event_id,
                        events_log=events_log,
                        timeout_s=timeout_s,
                        from_offset=offset_bytes,
                        intents_dir=intents_dir,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                    )
                    if rc != 0:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f"Script event {base_event_id} failed (rc={rc}): {receipt}"
                        )
                    results[agent_id].append(
                        {"event_id": base_event_id, "rc": rc, "receipt": receipt}
                    )
                else:
                    use_stale = demo_stale_rebase and step_idx == 1
                    res = _enqueue_and_wait_gui_with_rebase(
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        base_event_id=base_event_id,
                        keys=step["keys"],
                        footprint=step["footprint"],
                        expect=step["expect"],
                        frames_dir=frames_dir,
                        intents_dir=intents_dir,
                        events_log=events_log,
                        timeout_s=timeout_s,
                        force_initial_stale=use_stale,
                    )
                    results[agent_id].append(res)
        except Exception as exc:
            with lock:
                errors.append(f"{agent_id}: {exc}")
            if agent_id != "camera-agent":
                builders_done.set()
        finally:
            if agent_id != "camera-agent":
                with lock:
                    builder_remaining -= 1
                    if builder_remaining <= 0:
                        builders_done.set()

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(role, steps), daemon=True)
        for role, steps in plan.items()
    ]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()

    if errors:
        raise RuntimeError("; ".join(errors))

    return {
        "mode": "live",
        "agents": num_agents,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "demo_stale_rebase": demo_stale_rebase,
        "output_dir": str(output_dir),
        "results": results,
    }


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="python3 -m swarm.agents.scripted_smoke",
        description="Deterministic scripted multi-agent smoke producer for ViewPoint Swarm.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--agents", type=int, choices=(2, 4), default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR))
    parser.add_argument("--frames-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_FRAMES_DIR))
    parser.add_argument("--intents-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_INTENTS_DIR))
    parser.add_argument("--events-log", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=f"smoke-{int(time.time())}")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-s", type=float, default=DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S)
    parser.add_argument("--resolution", default="1280x720")
    parser.add_argument("--demo-stale-rebase", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    res_parts = args.resolution.lower().split("x")
    res_x, res_y = int(res_parts[0]), int(res_parts[1])

    summary = run_smoke(
        num_agents=args.agents,
        output_dir=Path(args.output_dir),
        frames_dir=Path(args.frames_dir),
        intents_dir=Path(args.intents_dir),
        events_log=resolve_events_log(args.events_log),
        run_id=args.run_id,
        timeout_s=args.timeout_s,
        demo_stale_rebase=args.demo_stale_rebase,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        res_x=res_x,
        res_y=res_y,
    )
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def _valid_footprint(fp: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(fp, list) or len(fp) != 4:
        return False
    return all(isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool) for v in fp) and fp[2] > 0 and fp[3] > 0


def _is_valid_event_id(event_id: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(event_id, str):
        return False
    if "/" in event_id or "\\" in event_id or ".." in event_id:
        return False
    return bool(EVENT_ID_RE.match(event_id))


def _safe_child_path(parent_dir: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
    if not filename or filename in (".", "..") or "/" in filename or "\\" in filename or ".." in filename:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsafe child filename: {filename!r}")
    resolved_parent = parent_dir.resolve()
    candidate = (resolved_parent / filename).resolve()
    if candidate.parent != resolved_parent:
        raise ValueError(f"Path traversal outside {resolved_parent}: {candidate}")
    return parent_dir / filename


def _safe_int_ts(val: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    if isinstance(val, bool) or val is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return int(val)
    if isinstance(val, str):
        try:
            return int(val.strip())
        except ValueError:
            return default
    return default


@dataclass
class BrokerConfig:
    job: str = DEFAULT_JOB
    vision_mode: str = "live"
    inbox_dir: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_INBOX", DEFAULT_INBOX)))
    outbox_dir: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_OUTBOX", DEFAULT_OUTBOX)))
    rejected_dir: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_REJECTED", DEFAULT_REJECTED)))
    frames_dir: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_FRAMES_DIR", DEFAULT_FRAMES_DIR)))
    intents_dir: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_INTENTS_DIR", DEFAULT_INTENTS_DIR)))
    events_log: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_EVENTS_LOG", DEFAULT_EVENTS_LOG)))
    nonce_file: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: Path(os.environ.get("SWARM_NONCE_FILE", DEFAULT_NONCE_FILE)))
    lease_ttl_ms: int = DEFAULT_LEASE_TTL_MS
    frame_ring_size: int = DEFAULT_FRAME_RING_SIZE
    script_timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_S
    gui_timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_GUI_TIMEOUT_S
    poll_ms: int = DEFAULT_POLL_MS
    max_ticks: int | None = None
    max_sweeps: int | None = None
    drain_and_exit: bool = False
    idle_timeout_s: float | None = None
    log_idle_pass: bool = False
    auto_rebase_viewport: bool = False
    auto_renew_leases: bool = True


class SwarmBroker:
    """Deterministic single-capsule turn-queue / actor broker."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: BrokerConfig,
        vision_runner: Callable[[list[str], float], subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]] | None = None,
        outbox_poll_hook: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.cfg = config
        self._vision_runner = vision_runner
        self._outbox_poll_hook = outbox_poll_hook
        self._stop_requested = False
        self._lock_fh: Any = None

        # Validate SWARM_BRIDGE_NONCE before acquiring resources
        env_nonce = os.environ.get("SWARM_BRIDGE_NONCE", "").strip()
        if env_nonce:
            if not NONCE_RE.match(env_nonce):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"SWARM_BRIDGE_NONCE must be 8-64 hex characters (got {env_nonce!r}); "
                    "use SWARM_NONCE_FILE for the nonce file path"
                )
            self.nonce = env_nonce.lower()
        else:
            self.nonce = secrets.token_hex(8)

        # Directories & exclusive broker lock
        self.cfg.events_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        lock_path = self.cfg.events_log.with_name(self.cfg.events_log.name + ".lock")
        self._lock_fh = lock_path.open("a+", encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(self._lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except OSError as exc:
            self._lock_fh.close()
            self._lock_fh = None
            raise RuntimeError(f"Another broker holds exclusive lock on {lock_path}") from exc

        try:
            self.cfg.inbox_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.cfg.outbox_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.cfg.rejected_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.cfg.frames_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            for agent_id in (*RING_AGENTS, DIRECTOR_AGENT):
                (self.cfg.intents_dir / agent_id).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (self.cfg.intents_dir / agent_id / "processed").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (self.cfg.intents_dir / agent_id / "rejected").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            atomic_write_text(self.cfg.nonce_file, self.nonce + "\n")

            # State machine & counters
            self.tick = 0
            self.turn = 0
            self.turn_epoch = 0
            self.view_epoch = 0
            self.scene_epoch = 0
            self.next_frame_seq = 0
            self.head_frame = 0
            self.frame_ring: deque[int] = deque(maxlen=max(1, self.cfg.frame_ring_size))
            self.prior_frame_png: Path | None = None

            self.fifos: dict[str, deque[dict[str, Any]]] = {a: deque() for a in RING_AGENTS}
            self.control_queue: deque[dict[str, Any]] = deque()
            self.seen_event_ids: set[str] = set()
            self.parked_agents: set[str] = set()
            self.consecutive_timeouts: dict[str, int] = {a: 0 for a in RING_AGENTS}
            self.actuator_busy: bool = False
            self._stale_drops: dict[str, int] = {}
            self._explicitly_expired_leases: set[str] = set()
            self.queue_state = "IDLE"
            self.ring_index = 0
            self.sweeps = 0
            self.last_activity = time.monotonic()

            # Issue initial leases
            self.leases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
            self._issue_initial_leases()

            # Capture initial frame_0
            self.capture_frame()
        except Exception:
            self.close()
            raise

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Release the exclusive broker lock file descriptor if held."""
        if self._lock_fh is not None:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(self._lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
            except OSError:
                pass
            try:
                self._lock_fh.close()
            except OSError:
                pass
            self._lock_fh = None

    def __del__(self) -> None:
        self.close()

    def request_stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop_requested = True

    def _emit_event(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        payload = {"v": 1, **record}
        line = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
        with self.cfg.events_log.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(line)
            fh.flush()

    def _issue_initial_leases(self) -> None:
        issued = now_ms()
        expires = issued + self.cfg.lease_ttl_ms
        for agent_id in RING_AGENTS:
            spec = DEFAULT_CLAIMS[agent_id]
            short = agent_id.split("-")[0]
            claim = {
                "v": 1,
                "rec": "claim",
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "lease_id": f"lease-{short}-0001",
                "lease_epoch": 1,
                "ttl_ms": self.cfg.lease_ttl_ms,
                "issued_ts_ms": issued,
                "expires_ts_ms": expires,
                "allow_gui": spec["allow_gui"],
                "write_prefixes": list(spec["write_prefixes"]),
            }

def _emit_close(
        self,
        *,
        tick: int,
        turn: int,
        event_id: str | None,
        agent_id: str,
        lane: str | None,
        verdict: str,
        rebased: bool = False,
        dispatch_capture_seq: int | None = None,
        verify_frame_ref: int | None = None,
        own_regions: list[list[int]] | None = None,
        spill_regions: list[list[int]] | None = None,
        drops: int = 0,
        reason: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        self._emit_event(
            {
                "rec": "close",
                "tick": tick,
                "turn": turn,
                "event_id": event_id,
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "lane": lane,
                "verdict": verdict,
                "rebased": rebased,
                "dispatch_capture_seq": dispatch_capture_seq,
                "verify_frame_ref": verify_frame_ref,
                "own_regions": own_regions if own_regions is not None else [],
                "spill_regions": spill_regions if spill_regions is not None else [],
                "drops": drops,
                "reason": reason,
                "ts_ms": now_ms(),
            }
        )

    def _archive_intent(self, path: Path, agent_id: str, subdir: str = "processed") -> None:
        dest_dir = self.cfg.intents_dir / agent_id / subdir
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest = dest_dir / path.name
        try:
            os.replace(path, dest)
        except OSError:
            shutil.move(str(path), str(dest))

    def ingest_intents(self) -> int:
        """Scan agent and director intent directories, archive consumed files, and enqueue."""
        ingested = 0

        # 1. Priority HI director-agent control files
        dir_path = self.cfg.intents_dir / DIRECTOR_AGENT
        if dir_path.is_dir():
            candidates: list[tuple[int, str, Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
            for p in dir_path.iterdir():
                if not p.is_file() or p.name.startswith(".") or p.name.endswith(".tmp") or p.suffix != ".json":
                    continue
                try:
                    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    if not isinstance(data, dict):
                        raise ValueError("director control payload must be a JSON object")
                    ts = _safe_int_ts(data.get("created_ts_ms", data.get("ts_ms", 0)), 0)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"[broker] warning: archiving malformed director control {p.name}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                    self._archive_intent(p, DIRECTOR_AGENT, subdir="rejected")
                    self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
                    continue
                candidates.append((ts, p.name, p, data))
            candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
            for _, _, p, data in candidates:
                self._archive_intent(p, DIRECTOR_AGENT, subdir="processed")
                self.control_queue.append(data)
                self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
                ingested += 1

        # 2. Planning agent intents
        for agent_id in RING_AGENTS:
            agent_dir = self.cfg.intents_dir / agent_id
            if not agent_dir.is_dir():
                continue
            loaded: list[tuple[int, str, Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
            for p in agent_dir.iterdir():
                if not p.is_file() or p.name.startswith(".") or p.name.endswith(".tmp") or p.suffix != ".json":
                    continue
                try:
                    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    if not isinstance(data, dict):
                        raise ValueError("intent payload must be a JSON object")
                    ts = _safe_int_ts(data.get("created_ts_ms"), 0)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"[broker] warning: archiving malformed intent {p.name}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                    self._archive_intent(p, agent_id, subdir="rejected")
                    self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
                    self._emit_close(
                        tick=self.tick,
                        turn=self.turn,
                        event_id=None,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        lane=None,
                        verdict="CLAIM_REFUSED",
                        reason="malformed intent JSON",
                    )
                    continue
                loaded.append((ts, p.name, p, data))

            loaded.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
            for _, _, p, data in loaded:
                self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
                raw_lane = data.get("lane")
                lane_val = raw_lane if isinstance(raw_lane, str) else None
                raw_event_id = data.get("event_id")

                if not _is_valid_event_id(raw_event_id):
                    self._archive_intent(p, agent_id, subdir="rejected")
                    self._emit_close(
                        tick=self.tick,
                        turn=self.turn,
                        event_id=None,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        lane=lane_val,
                        verdict="CLAIM_REFUSED",
                        reason="missing or invalid event_id",
                    )
                    continue

                self._archive_intent(p, agent_id, subdir="processed")
                event_id = str(raw_event_id)

                if event_id in self.seen_event_ids:
                    self._emit_close(
                        tick=self.tick,
                        turn=self.turn,
                        event_id=event_id,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        lane=lane_val,
                        verdict="DUPLICATE_EVENT",
                        reason="duplicate event_id",
                    )
                    continue

                if len(self.fifos[agent_id]) >= MAX_FIFO:
                    self._emit_close(
                        tick=self.tick,
                        turn=self.turn,
                        event_id=event_id,
                        agent_id=agent_id,
                        lane=lane_val,
                        verdict="QUEUE_FULL",
                        reason="fifo capacity 8 reached",
                    )
                    continue

                self.seen_event_ids.add(event_id)
                item = dict(data)
                item.pop("_drops", None)
                item.pop("drops", None)
                item.pop("rebased", None)
                item.pop("_rebased", None)
                item["_dir_agent_id"] = agent_id
                self._stale_drops[event_id] = 0
                self.fifos[agent_id].append(item)
                self._emit_enqueue_record(item, agent_id, event_id)
                self._emit_cursor(
                    agent_id=agent_id,
                    event_id=event_id,
                    phase="intent",
                    label=f"{agent_id}: enqueue {item.get('kind', 'intent')}",
                    cursor_xy=item.get("cursor_xy"),
                )
                ingested += 1

        return ingested

    def _emit_enqueue_record(self, item: dict[str, Any], agent_id: str, event_id: str) -> None:
        self._emit_event(
            {
                "rec": "enqueue",
                "event_id": event_id,
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "lane": item.get("lane"),
                "action_class": item.get("action_class"),
                "kind": item.get("kind"),
                "based_on_frame": item.get("based_on_frame"),
                "view_epoch": item.get("view_epoch"),
                "scene_epoch": item.get("scene_epoch"),
                "lease_epoch": item.get("lease_epoch"),
                "write_set": item.get("write_set", []),
                "target_region": item.get("target_region"),
                "footprint": item.get("footprint"),
                "expect": item.get("expect", ""),
                "script_sha256": item.get("script_sha256"),
                "max_acts": item.get("max_acts", 1),
                "ts_ms": now_ms(),
            }
        )

    def apply_control_events(self) -> None:
        """Apply queued `director-agent` control events strictly at turn boundaries."""
        while self.control_queue:
            ctrl = self.control_queue.popleft()

def expire_lease(self, agent_id: str) -> None:
        """Explicitly expire an agent's lease for negative-control testing."""
        self._explicitly_expired_leases.add(agent_id)
        claim = self.leases.get(agent_id)
        if claim is not None:
            claim["expires_ts_ms"] = now_ms() - 1

    def renew_lease(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Renew an active unparked agent's lease while keeping `lease_epoch` unchanged."""
        claim = self.leases.get(agent_id)
        if claim is None or agent_id in self.parked_agents or agent_id in self._explicitly_expired_leases:
            return None
        issued = now_ms()
        claim["issued_ts_ms"] = issued
        claim["expires_ts_ms"] = issued + int(claim["ttl_ms"])
        self._emit_event(dict(claim))
        return claim

    def _maybe_renew_lease(self, agent_id: str) -> None:
        if not self.cfg.auto_renew_leases:
            return
        if agent_id in self.parked_agents or agent_id in self._explicitly_expired_leases:
            return
        claim = self.leases.get(agent_id)
        if claim is None:
            return
        ttl_ms = int(claim["ttl_ms"])
        renew_at = int(claim["expires_ts_ms"]) - (ttl_ms // 4)
        if now_ms() >= renew_at:
            self.renew_lease(agent_id)

    def _validate_lease(self, agent_id: str, intent: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
        claim = self.leases.get(agent_id)
        if claim is None:
            return "NO_LEASE"
        if intent.get("agent_id") != agent_id:
            return "CLAIM_REFUSED"
        if intent.get("lease_epoch") != claim["lease_epoch"]:
            return "LEASE_EXPIRED"
        self._maybe_renew_lease(agent_id)
        if now_ms() > claim["expires_ts_ms"]:
            return "LEASE_EXPIRED"
        return None

    def _handle_script_intent(self, agent_id: str, intent: dict[str, Any], claim: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        event_id = str(intent["event_id"])
        write_set = intent.get("write_set")
        prefixes = claim["write_prefixes"]

        if (
            not isinstance(write_set, list)
            or len(write_set) == 0
            or not all(isinstance(w, str) and any(w.startswith(p) for p in prefixes) for w in write_set)
        ):
            self._emit_close(
                tick=self.tick,
                turn=self.turn,
                event_id=event_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,
                lane="script",
                verdict="CLAIM_REFUSED",
                reason="write_set outside active write_prefixes",
            )
            return

        script = intent.get("script")
        if not isinstance(script, str) or not script.strip():
            self._emit_close(
                tick=self.tick,
                turn=self.turn,
                event_id=event_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,
                lane="script",
                verdict="CLAIM_REFUSED",
                reason="empty script source",
            )
            return

        expected_sha = intent.get("script_sha256")
        if expected_sha is not None:
            actual_sha = hashlib.sha256(script.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            if actual_sha != expected_sha:
                self._emit_close(
                    tick=self.tick,
                    turn=self.turn,
                    event_id=event_id,
                    agent_id=agent_id,
                    lane="script",
                    verdict="CLAIM_REFUSED",
                    reason="script_sha256 mismatch",
                )
                return

        self._emit_cursor(
            agent_id=agent_id,
            event_id=event_id,
            phase="act",
            label=f"{agent_id}: exec script",
            cursor_xy=intent.get("cursor_xy"),
        )

        dispatch_seq = self.tick + 1
        job_name = f"{self.nonce}__{dispatch_seq}__{event_id}.py"
        receipt_name = f"{self.nonce}__{dispatch_seq}__{event_id}.json"
        try:
            inbox_path = _safe_child_path(self.cfg.inbox_dir, job_name)
            outbox_path = _safe_child_path(self.cfg.outbox_dir, receipt_name)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._emit_close(
                tick=self.tick,
                turn=self.turn,
                event_id=event_id,

                lane="script",

        atomic_write_text(inbox_path, script)

        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.cfg.script_timeout_s
        receipt: Any = None
        corrupt = False

        while True:
            if self._outbox_poll_hook is not None:
                self._outbox_poll_hook()
            if outbox_path.is_file():
                try:
                    receipt = json.loads(outbox_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                except Exception:
                    corrupt = True
                break
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            time.sleep(0.01)

        if corrupt:
            self.tick += 1
            self.queue_state = "RECONCILE"
            self._emit_close(
                tick=self.tick,
                turn=self.turn,
                event_id=event_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,

            self.turn_epoch += 1
            self.actuator_busy = True
            self.queue_state = "RECONCILE"
            self.consecutive_timeouts[agent_id] += 1
            self._emit_close(
                tick=self.tick,
                turn=self.turn,
                event_id=event_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,
                lane="script",
                verdict="TURN_TIMEOUT",
                dispatch_capture_seq=dispatch_frame,
                verify_frame_ref=None,
                reason=f"bridge receipt timeout after {self.cfg.script_timeout_s}s",
            )
            if self.consecutive_timeouts[agent_id] >= CONSECUTIVE_TIMEOUT_PARK:

                        "reason": f"{agent_id}: 2 consecutive TURN_TIMEOUT",
                        "ts_ms": now_ms(),
                    }
                )
            return

        if not isinstance(receipt, dict):
            self.tick += 1
            self.queue_state = "RECONCILE"
            self._emit_close(

                event_id=event_id,
